p.seg: Then Brilliant Effulgence wasnot able to ask (further), but narrowly looked for Nonentity'sform,
He looked for a whole day,but could not see it.
He listened for it, but could nothear it.
He clutched at it but could not get it.
who is able toattain to such a pitch as this?
but I cannot[reach a state of] non-existing non-existence,

How can Iarrive at this state [of negative non-existence]?【Note,—The following translation of thissuggested to me by a friend :—予 I 能 can 有 exist 無(generated by) Vacuum;而 but 未能I cannot be 無無 without beginning and without end (i.e. self-existent)及even unto (i.e. thus) 為 becoming like 無有 (you) Wu-yui.e. a Mr. Vacuum).】
